g.id: Original editable material / Detailed product journeys

path.id: Prepare for a conversation in the city.

For people unfamiliar with the local language, asking for directions, buying a ticket or speaking to a vendor can feel difficult. Not knowing what to say or how to pronounce it can make them hesitant to start a conversation.
Situation-based lessons provide a focused starting point. Short learning cards connect the supporting feature to moments of communication.

g.id: Original screens & anchored explanations / LANGUAGE LEARNING

path.id: Choosing a familiar context can make the learning task easier to understand.
Small steps are intended to make practice approachable.
Check whether people can find, understand and use the phrase they need. Learning gains are not yet measured.
